title: Record host-observed build commands as typed Build verification on the claim's checkpoint
acceptance: A claimed turn that runs a genuine build command records one Build verification on its closing checkpoint, passed or failed per the command's outcome, with source revision and environment; a test covers each outcome.
A test command is still recorded as Test, and no command is recorded as both kinds; a non-build command that merely mentions 'build' is not recorded as Build.
Engram accepts the recorded Build verification against a criterion bound to kind build; a test or a recorded live check shows it.

completion.summary: Typed Build verification landed and installed from the exact reviewed/gated tree; independent acceptance passed all three criteria.
